state.goal: Score how heavily Workday's public AI marketing positions investment/emphasis in HR, IT, and Finance based only on the supplied page evidence. This is a content-signal score, not a claim about actual R&D spend or dollars invested.

source.page_title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Solutions for Business | Workday US

scoring_policy.definition: AI investment heaviness means how strongly the page allocates named product framing, concrete AI capabilities, quantified outcomes, and customer proof to that domain versus treating it as a generic mention.
do_not_infer: Do not invent capabilities, metrics, customers, or headcount not present in state.evidence.
Do not treat shared platform claims as equal domain investment unless the domain is explicitly named with those claims.
Do not score Legal or other domains; only HR, Finance, and IT.
Scores compare relative marketing emphasis on this page, not absolute corporate investment.
levels: Absent or incidental: domain is not given a dedicated AI product section; only a list mention or no usable evidence.
Named but thin: dedicated domain label or short blurb exists, but capabilities are generic and there is no domain-linked quantified outcome or customer proof.
Substantive: dedicated agentic/product narrative plus at least one concrete domain capability OR one domain-linked quantified outcome/customer proof.
Heavy: dedicated narrative with multiple concrete domain capabilities AND at least one domain-linked quantified outcome or customer proof on this page.

shared_platform: Hero: 'AI that truly knows your business' with Sana automating work across HR, finance, IT, and beyond.
Platform claim: built on Workday data; integrate business apps; build, orchestrate, and manage agents across business functions.
Trust/platform pillars: humans at the center; value-centric innovation; unrivaled data and context; open extensible platform; proven responsible AI (ISO 42001); flex credits usage-based pricing.
Customer proof spanning domains: 'Medidata has saved over $1.46 million annually in costs through the automation of finance and HR workflows.'

hr.dedicated_section: Agentic HR. Drive operational excellence by empowering your people, elevating managers, and automating processes with AI built for HR.
capability_signals: Amplify talent potential: free people from mundane tasks; more time for skills and growth
customer_proof: Medidata automation of finance and HR workflows ($1.46M annual savings cited jointly with finance)

finance.dedicated_section: Agentic Finance. Go from hindsight to insight with AI that surfaces exceptions, anticipates change, and predicts the next best action.
capability_signals: Improve strategic decisions / insights framing appears in general ROI section
quantified_outcomes: 49% increase in financial planning and analysis efficiency
customer_proof: Medidata automation of finance and HR workflows ($1.46M annual savings cited jointly with HR)

it.dedicated_section: Agentic IT. Realize ROI fast and deliver transformational outcomes by partnering with an AI platform driven by trust, agility, and quality data you can always rely on.
capability_signals: Shared platform: build/orchestrate/manage agents; open extensible platform; flex credits

explicitly_out_of_scope_on_page: Agentic Legal section and 70% reduction in outside legal spend are present on the page but must not be scored as HR/IT/Finance investment.

page_evidence_enough_to_compare.instructions: Is the supplied page evidence sufficient to compare relative AI marketing emphasis across HR, Finance, and IT without needing other Workday pages?

criteria.true: Each of HR, Finance, and IT has a dedicated section or clearly attributable signals on this page, enough to place them on the scoring_policy levels.
criteria.false: At least one target domain lacks attributable evidence, or the page is too generic to support a three-way comparison.

heaviest_domain_on_page.instructions: Which domain shows the heaviest AI investment emphasis on this page under state.scoring_policy? Prefer domains with dedicated narrative plus quantified outcomes/customer proof. Choose tie only if two or more are equally heavy; choose insufficient_evidence if comparison is not supportable.

criteria.hr: HR has the strongest combination of dedicated narrative, concrete capabilities, and domain-linked outcomes/proof.
criteria.finance: Finance has the strongest combination of dedicated narrative, concrete capabilities, and domain-linked outcomes/proof.
criteria.it: IT has the strongest combination of dedicated narrative, concrete capabilities, and domain-linked outcomes/proof.
criteria.tie: Two or more of HR/Finance/IT are equally heavy on the supplied evidence.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The page does not support a reliable heaviest-domain choice.
